bias.en: Rebound · SAR flipped bullish, above the 200-day
bias.zh: 反弹 · 抛物线 SAR 转为看多，站上 200 日均线

read.en: TSMC rose 4.3% on Nov 11 to $413.35, trading $407.03–416.80. It is above the 5-day ($385.4), 10-day ($396.4) and rising 200-day ($402.4) and below the 100-day ($426.1) and 30-day ($427.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9, below zero, histogram narrowing toward a cross; Parabolic SAR flipped bullish on Nov 11 ($351.19), and RSI is 49.6.
read.zh: 台积电 11月11日上涨 4.3%，收于 $413.35，盘中区间 $407.03–416.80。股价位于 5 日（$385.4）、10 日（$396.4）和上行的 200 日均线（$402.4）上方，100 日（$426.1）和 30 日均线（$427.0）下方。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄、接近上穿；抛物线 SAR 于 11月11日转为看多（$351.19），RSI 为 49.6。

read.en: The gap higher cleared the 10 and 200-day and the $410.6 Nov 4 high, now support; the $416.80 high stopped just above the $414.8 Nov 2 high. Resistance is $414.8–416.8, then $419.2 (Jun 26 low) and $426–427 (100 and 30-day). Support is $407–410.6 (Oct 15 and Nov 11 lows, Nov 4 high), then $396.4–402.4 (10 and 200-day) and $385.4–387.2. A close above $416.8 would target $419–427; below $407, $396–402.

s.en: Nov 11 low $407.03; Oct 15 low $407.13; Nov 4 high $410.59, cleared
